basic_info.description: Welcome to 371 Wawona Ave, a beautifully updated 1920s home nestled on a coveted tree-lined street in SF's West Portal. Steps from vibrant shops & restaurants, this home seamlessly blends timeless character w/ modern comforts & a seismic retrofit for peace of mind. Step in to discover original 1920s craftsmanship: preserved wood trim, coffered ceilings, & pristine hardwood floors. Modern updates, like new lighting & a remodeled kitchen w/ sleek appliances create a truly inviting atmosphere. The spacious living room is bathed in natural light from 3 oversized windows, flowing seamlessly into a large dining area, perfect for gatherings. The main lvl also boasts 2 spacious bedrooms & a luxurious remodeled bath w/ a soaking tub. Modernized systems incl. a new H2O heater, furnace, & electrical upgrades. Downstairs, a newly constructed family room awaits, complete w/ wide plank oak floors, recessed lighting, & a stunning full bath w/ dual vanities & a glass-enclosed shower. A private primary suite offers a peaceful retreat. Laundry w/ high-efficiency appliances adds convenience. Step outside to a private backyard oasis w/ new turf, vibrant greenery, & a mature lemon tree. Southern exposure ensures this space is bathed in sunlight. This abode is a rare gem, ready for you to call home.
